overall_summary: The channel shows very low overall view counts across all recent uploads, indicating the algorithm is still in the exploration phase or audience reach is heavily constrained. While data sample size is too small to declare definitive winning patterns, content focusing on tangible, modern smartphone-era relationship artifacts (like phone numbers, saved names, and chat logs) performed slightly better on average.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing phone numbers or saved names ('आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है', 'नंबर पर अभी भी तेरी तस्वीर है') generated the highest views (20 and 15 respectively) relative to the rest of the batch.
winning_patterns.action: Continue leveraging modern smartphone isolation motifs as anchor points for emotional storytelling.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks describing passive observation of others online ('घंटों से वो ऑनलाइन दिख रहा है') resulted in 0 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive stalking hooks and instead focus on direct, personal interaction remnants like notifications, blocked statuses, or saved drafts.
